author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override kd22 k50 δ0.12 emb_k=17 γ_max=0.76 (DAQB)
abstract: Same as kd=22,k=50,δ=0.12 with embedding neighbors=17, but increases γ_max clamp from 0.74→0.76 to alleviate over-shrinkage and potentially improve biology (Cell_cycle) without harming PCR.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.12,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=50,
        gamma_max=0.76,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
